text:
Predicates:
F1Visa(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1Visa(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student in US.
CPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
OPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
Work(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → F1Visa(x) ⊕ J1Visa(x)) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (F1Visa(x) ∧ Work(x) → CPT(x) ∨ OPT(x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
CPT(mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
F1Visa(mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
